headline: Method Actor Refuses To Break Character During Six-Month Grocery Run To Prepare For Role As ‘Man Who Buys Milk’
body:
Rahul Varma, a prominent lead actor currently filming a gritty urban drama, was spotted at a local suburban supermarket this morning, silently weighing fifteen different brands of dairy for over four hours to accurately capture the existential dread of a household provider. The actor, who is reportedly paid a fee exceeding most medium-sized corporate budgets, insists that he cannot exit the character of ‘The Consumer’ until he has successfully memorized the nutritional labels of every shelf in aisle four.

“I’m not just buying milk, I’m experiencing the caloric desperation of the middle class,” Varma whispered to a bemused store manager while staring intensely at a carton of low-fat Greek yogurt. The actor’s production team has cordoned off the dairy section with velvet ropes, allowing Varma to practice his ‘pensive check-out’ walk for three weeks straight. His co-star, who is playing a ‘Professional Commuter,’ is currently living in the store's parking lot to ensure her character’s exhaustion levels remain authentic.

Critics have praised the level of commitment, noting that Varma’s skin has taken on a faint, chalky hue from lack of sunlight and excessive exposure to supermarket fluorescent lighting. The film’s director confirmed that the entire grocery scene, which lasts approximately forty-five seconds in the final cut, will be filmed in one single take once Varma achieves what he calls ‘Peak Domestic Resonance.’
caption: The price of art, or just the price of dairy? Rahul Varma is leaving it all on the shelf for his upcoming role. #Bollywood #MethodActing #Cinema #TafriTimes (satire)
